{{Top|canon=Enslaver}}
[[File:Befriend_a_Wookiee.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavers]]
{{Quote|I never knew what your tattoos meant. Jarael&mdash;before Camper found you&mdash;were you a ''slave''?''"<br />"''No, Zayne&hellip; I was a ''slaver''.|[[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Jarael]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 41">[[Knights of the Old Republic 41|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 41]]</ref>}}
A '''slaver''' was an individual who practiced and engaged in the business of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. In [[3956 BBY]], [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] slavers took the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Zaalbar]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], who had to be rescued by an [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesiac]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>
